WITH regional AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region,
           AVG(t.amount) AS average_amount,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
), cross_region AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS mean_regional_average
    FROM regional
)
SELECT AVG(r.average_amount) AS mean_of_above_average_regions,
       AVG(r.transaction_count) AS mean_transaction_count,
       AVG(r.average_amount - c.mean_regional_average) AS mean_excess_amount
FROM regional AS r
CROSS JOIN cross_region AS c
WHERE r.average_amount > c.mean_regional_average;
